sloka: ततस्तु सचिवैः सार्धं षड्भिर्नित्यं बलोद्धतैः ।महोदरप्रहस्ताभ्यां मारीचशुकसारणैः ।। ७.१४.१ ॥
transliteration: tatastu sacivaiḥ sārdhaṁ ṣaḍbhirnityaṁ baloddhataiḥ ।mahodaraprahastābhyāṁ mārīcaśukasāraṇaiḥ ।। 7.14.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, accompanied by six powerful ministers, including Mahodara, Prahasta, Maricha, Shuka, and Sarana, he proceeded.
